pack.title: Alpha V2.5.1
pack.summary: Release V2.5.1. 3 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Corvus now reads the pack's name from what this site publishes, instead of having it written into the app. Until now it always said "Glimpse Alpha" on its main screen — which became wrong the moment the pack was renamed to "Alpha", and could only have been corrected by shipping a new launcher. It now follows the name published here, so a future rename needs no launcher update at all. Nothing about updating, Play or Settings has changed. This release also rewrites several log messages that were showing raw internal detail rather than a sentence — including one that reported a failure as simply "null", which told you nothing about what had gone wrong.
